verdict.rationale: Godot exposes a documented command-line interface, EditorScript/EditorInterface APIs, GDExtension/GDScript scripting, and headless mode for automation-driven use, which together let an AI-native user script and drive the engine programmatically. However, there is no unified 'public API' spec like an OpenAPI/REST interface (probes for llms.txt, openapi.json all 404), and no dedicated machine-readable API for AI agents beyond general scripting/CLI docs. missing for 10: a formal API schema (OpenAPI/REST) or llms.txt-style machine-readable API index, first-party AI-agent integration docs, independent confirmation of programmatic control beyond CLI/editor scripting.
